LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 DETERMINERS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we indicate that something belongs to somebody?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify articles and possessives in texts
2. use articles and possessives in sentences

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 DETERMINERS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify articles and possessives in texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use articles and possessives in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we indicate that something belongs to somebody?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify articles and possessives in texts
2. use articles and possessives in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
